note: The source saturates the detector, so each point is the mean surface brightness of the ring of light around it (3.5-6.5 pixels), in MJy/sr. This follows the brightness at a fixed wavelength but is not a calibrated flux: the ring holds a different share of the light at every wavelength, so the shape of this curve is not the spectrum of the star, and the level steps between detectors.
